name: Poisoned Path
source:
Rinako Kurosawa had no idea that the evening she wanted to surprise her family would be a night that would completely change the course of her life. An argument between her father and brother leads to the complete breakdown of her family. Her brother leaves home, and a mysterious traffic accident takes her mother and father from her.

When the authorities were helpless, she decided to risk her life and became a police detective. Unaware that this decision would turn her entire reality upside down, one morning the task assigned to her turned her newly established life into a lie:

“Infiltrate the yakuza leader's gang, gain their trust, and bring down the organization. Even if you can't bring them down, gather information and report it to the government.”

Will he emerge from the lies and darkness into the light? Or will he sink deeper into the swamp? Who knows? Would you like to find out with him?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4509000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
黑泽莉奈子并不知道，她想要给家人一个惊喜的那个夜晚将是一个彻底改变她人生轨迹的夜晚。她的父亲和兄弟之间的争吵导致她的家庭彻底破裂。她的哥哥离家出走，一场神秘的交通事故夺走了她的父母。

当当局束手无策时，她决定冒着生命危险，成为一名警探。没有意识到这个决定会颠覆她的整个现实，一天早上分配给她的任务让她新建立的生活变成了谎言：

“渗透到黑帮头目团伙中，取得他们的信任，打倒这个组织。即使打不倒他们，也要收集信息并向政府报告。”

他能否走出谎言和黑暗，走向光明？还是会陷入沼泽更深的地方？谁知道？你想和他一起去了解一下吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4509000/]Steam[/url]]
